The brief

Built like Zara.
Counted at the till.

On WhatsApp we promised: "We'd take it one step further, from the post to the billing counter. Content and experiential that pull people into stores, measured on footfall per store. Give us one store launch or one festive drop as a test. If the numbers don't move, you lose nothing." This is how.

The gap

Bigger than Zara. Not yet busier.

31122Zara India stores

Westside has 311 stores to Zara India's 22, and on our estimate sells more in total. Each Zara store sells several times more. In the posts we could find, Westside's content seldom ends at a named store, so most frames carry no address.

The idea · the style account

@seenatwestside

Style is the IP. The account is the magazine.

Westside's own @TargetStyle: one style account beside @westsidestores, where the eight properties run as series. @TargetStyle has always ended online: a product page in 2014, in-app checkout in 2020. This one ends at a store.

Handle@seenatwestside
SeriesEight, one highlight each
@westsidestoresKeeps offers, launches and store news

Launch
A hosted premiere, the way Target relaunched @TargetStyle. @westsidestores announces it the day before with a clue to Window No. 001. The account goes live on preview night, the evening before the pilot store opens: in-store Stories, a host (a stand-up comic or a named Westside stylist, never a model) and an RSVP for Sunday's styling hour. In the festive-drop option it premieres with Five Functions Episode 01. It starts with one store and adds stores as they join.

Borrowed from Target Style: a style handle beside @Target since at least 2014 (2.2M followers to @Target's 4.4M in May 2020), relaunched on 13 Sept 2025 at the Target Style Tailgate during New York Fashion Week, as a hosted live premiere with five set formats. We found no Indian fashion retailer running a dedicated style account.

Reference · what we borrow

Few. Named. Numbered. Dated.

Zara makes IP that feels like a collection. Target Style gives style its own account. We add a store at the end of every post.

Zara · few, named, numbered
  • Zara SRPLSNumbered collections, CLLCTN 02 (2019) to CLLCTN 16 (Apr 2026), under one credited creative director. Source
  • Zara StudioA stable core crew and a palette declared each season (SS26: powder blue, sage, blush). Source
  • The Fold-erBylined columns inside the app, with a shop link under every image (12 Jun 2026). Source
  • Zara NanjingA bookable fit-check and content studio inside the flagship (Mar 2025). Source
  • PremieresOne room, by appointment, before the wide release: Re{form} by John Galliano, Marais, 1–6 Oct 2026. Source
Target Style · style as its own account
  • Own accountA Target-owned style handle beside @Target since at least 27 Aug 2014, when both profiles got a shoppable link (Curalate Like2Buy). Source
  • Half the reachMay 2020: about 2.2M followers against @Target's 4.4M, described as a separate account focused on fashion and beauty. Source
  • Hosted premiereRelaunched 13 Sept 2025 for a 'social-first fashion audience', with live BTS from the Target Style Tailgate during New York Fashion Week hosted by comedian Christina Kirkman. Source
  • Fixed formatsSept 2025 format list: fall trend spotlights, NYC micro-creator collabs, street-style snapshots, trend edits, stylist tips. No numbered series found. Source
  • Tag to featureOn Target.com: 'Just post a picture and tag @TargetStyle and you might just see yourself, too!' Source
  • Online, not storeIts link sends people to product pages (2014) and in-app checkout (2020). We found no store action or footfall figure for the account. That is the gap Westside fills. Source

Text only by design: no Zara or Target logos, photos or screenshots anywhere in this proposal.

The store

From the post to the billing counter.

Five steps, each one counted per store.

01See

A Window, a Trial Room episode or a Seen In wall, each naming one store.

Specificity: a named place turns "nice" into a plan.
02Tap

BOOK, HOLD or RSVP on that store's WhatsApp with a property code.

Commitment: a dated slot, not a like.
03Visit

Your size is held, or your stylist is waiting.

Endowment: what is already yours is hard to give up.
04Bill

The WestStyleClub ID and the code are captured at the counter.

The loop closes per store.
05Return

Collect a portrait or an alteration, or use a 30-day Style Call card.

A second visit is built in.

The City PageStyle

Mumbai's new Friday ritual is a shop window

Westside numbers one look a week, in every one of its 311 windows. Members see it on Thursday night.

By Saturday afternoon the rail inside the D.N. Nagar door is half empty, and the store's WhatsApp has a list of holds waiting for Sunday. Window No. 047 is a blazer and trousers called 'Office, Monday'. The format is simple, and that is the point: any of the 311 store teams can dress it on a Friday morning.

One opening. Eight weeks.

One store. Eight weeks.

First Look · your first Q4 FY27 opening

Five Functions, Edition 01

You lose nothing if the numbers don't move

No agency fee unless verified footfall beats the comparison by the threshold we agree up front. Production and media at cost, approved upfront.

Store
Westside's first Q4 FY27 opening, in a city chosen with Trent, plus three cluster stores for The Trial Room. Counters in before it opens.
Runs
@seenatwestside premieres on preview night. First Look holds the bay for weeks 1–4, then Window No. 001. The Trial Room with 4 stylists. Seen In on the opening Saturday and in week 5. About 15–30 catchment Regulars.
Read
Weeks 1–8 entries per sq ft against matched Q4 FY26 openings; the cluster stores like-for-like against matched controls. Readout at opening + 10 weeks.
Store
One existing high-footfall store with spare alteration capacity (illustrative: Westside Sky Vista, D.N. Nagar, Mumbai).
Runs
@seenatwestside premieres with Five Functions Episode 01. Bring the Card sessions, five episodes and Trial Room bookings.
Read
Difference-in-differences on a 12-week baseline against 3–5 matched stores, with the January sale matched in the controls.
